title: Wrapmate VW ID.Buzz configurator
tagline: See a custom wrap on the vehicle before ordering
context: Wrapmate sells vehicle wraps. The configurator lets customers see a custom wrap on a VW ID.Buzz in real time before ordering.
delivered: A real-time 3D configurator for the VW ID.Buzz
Built with React, TypeScript, Three.js and WebGL, with a Node and Express back end
